name: lora-strength-CHANGE-ME
_why: Template, not queued. Copy it once a LoRA is installed on the desktop: set name, the LoRA filename (as ComfyUI lists it; see the Sampler panel), its trigger words in the prompt, then stage with tools/stage_sweep.py. Compares no LoRA against three strengths on shared seeds. Too low and the character drifts back to generic; too high and the LoRA's training images bleed in (same pose, same background, burnt colours). Hires is left off so each cell is quick.

base.prompt: TRIGGER WORDS, CHARACTER TAG, zenless zone zero, 1girl, solo, looking at viewer, cowboy shot, city street at night, neon lights, cinematic lighting, detailed background
